description: This file defines and implements the 'Caps' class and related functions for managing OpenGL texture and rendering capabilities, extension support, and hardware limits within the ANGLE project. It includes methods for querying maximum samples, supported formats, and extension features, as well as initializing capability data based on client version and extensions.

classes.name: TextureCaps
classes.description: Represents the capabilities of a specific texture format, including support for texturing, filtering, attachments, renderbuffer support, and supported sample counts.

classes.name: TextureCapsMap
classes.description: Manages a collection of TextureCaps objects indexed by internal format or format ID.

classes.name: Extensions
classes.description: Tracks support for various OpenGL extensions and provides a method to retrieve supported extension strings.

classes.name: Limitations
classes.description: Represents hardware or implementation limitations, currently minimal.

classes.name: Caps
classes.description: Encapsulates various graphics capabilities, limits, and extension support, with functions to generate minimum capabilities based on client version and extensions.

classes.name: TypePrecision
classes.description: Describes precision and range for shader data types.

methods.name: getMaxSamples
methods.description: Returns the maximum supported sample count for textures.

methods.name: getNearestSamples
methods.description: Returns the nearest supported sample count greater than or equal to the requested number.

methods.name: GenerateMinimumTextureCaps
methods.description: Creates a TextureCaps object with minimum supported features for a given internal format, client version, and extensions.

methods.name: InitMinimumTextureCapsMap
methods.description: Initializes a TextureCapsMap with minimum capabilities for all formats based on client version and extensions.

methods.name: setTextureExtensionSupport
methods.description: Sets support flags for various texture extensions based on the provided TextureCapsMap.

methods.name: getStrings
methods.description: Returns a list of supported extension strings.
